Run the steps below in order from the calcphi.com-1 project root. Phase 1 (fixer.py) fixes deterministic issues automatically — regulatory citations, author attribution, internal links. Phase 2 requires manually expanding thin content per the agents/sentinel-fixer.md spec.

1
Apply deterministic fixes (Phase 1)
Injects ATO/SEBI/RBI regulatory source citations, author byline, and <time> element into every failing page. Also adds Related Calculators links where in-content count < 3. Idempotent — safe to re-run.
python3 scripts/sentinel/fixer.py
2
Re-score all pages
Evaluates all 9 signals (word count, editorial depth, eeat, js dependency, internal links, etc.) per page and writes updated scores to cache/page_scores.json. Takes ~30 seconds.
python3 scripts/sentinel/scorer.py
3
Run near-duplicate clustering
Generates embeddings for all pages, clusters by cosine similarity > 0.85, and updates the info_gain signal for pages in duplicate clusters. Required before report — skipping this leaves info_gain as neutral placeholders.
python3 scripts/sentinel/duplicates.py
4
Rebuild this report
Computes the rollup, updates reports/adsense/latest.json, and regenerates this dashboard at _site/warroom/index.html. The new pass rate and failing pages list reflect all fixes applied so far.
python3 scripts/sentinel/report.py
5
Commit and push to Vercel
Deploys all fixed _site/ HTML to production. Vercel serves _site/ directly — no build step. Changes go live within 30–60 seconds of push.
git add _site/ scripts/sentinel/ && git commit -m "AdSense Fixer: apply fixes" && git push origin main
6
Re-crawl live site & get verified score
After Vercel deploys, crawl the live site to get the true post-fix sentinel score. This is the only verified reading — local cache simulations may differ from what Googlebot sees.
python3 scripts/sentinel/crawler.py && python3 scripts/sentinel/scorer.py && python3 scripts/sentinel/duplicates.py && python3 scripts/sentinel/report.py
